A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

LOSs of M. marinum are decorated with two different fatty acid chains that are transferred onto the trehalose moiety through the action of PapA4, an enzyme that is likely involved in the assembly and acylation of trehalose-based mycobacterial lipoglycans.
